description: Curated Google Fonts Casting Library for OpenFilm (free for commercial use, dynamic Latin & CJK subsetting).

castings.mood: Title sequences, high-craft editorial, documentary essays, restrained authority (A24 / literary feel)
castings.notes: High-contrast serif carries cinematic weight; pair with small wide-tracked mono metadata (tracking 0.16-0.18em) for quiet editorial contrast.

castings.mood: Swiss graphic design, modern SaaS, crisp explainers, clean technical clarity
castings.notes: Use extreme weight contrast (300 vs 900) and bold scale ratios (5:1+) to build pure modernist hierarchy.

castings.mood: Archival print, bold poster manifestos, kinetic intros, high-velocity typographic punch
castings.notes: Ultra-condensed heavy display with tight leading (line-height 0.94-1.02); pairs naturally with halftone grain and duotone print palettes.

castings.mood: Warm humanist storytelling, personal essays, tactile paper & ink
castings.notes: Organic handwritten warmth paired with italic Newsreader and warm cotton paper surfaces.

castings.mood: Luxury branding, architectural elegance, slow-paced contemplative titles
castings.notes: Hairline serif strokes paired with generous negative space for refined brand lockups.

castings.mood: Research dossiers, engineering benchmarks, financial & scientific data storytelling
